summary: Firefox is integrating Skrifa, a modern font library, deeper into its text rendering pipeline to handle font metrics, character tables, and font names more efficiently. This refactoring moves font operations away from older code paths to Skrifa's more reliable implementation, which provides better support for modern font features like variable fonts (fonts that can smoothly change weight or width without separate downloads). The work also improves font caching and memory management to reduce overhead during text layout and rendering.
